scripts.test: turbo test && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests tests/integration && python3 tools/source_registry/validate.py >/dev/null && python3 -m unittest tools/source_registry/test_validate.py
scripts.lint: turbo lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: turbo typecheck && uv run --project apps/api pyright
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.format: turbo format && uv run --project apps/api ruff format .
